switch.$description: Switch track and thumb. Component tokens reference semantic tokens; a literal here is a decision this component owns, and the description is why. The on/off distinction is carried three ways so it never rests on hue: the thumb's position, the track fill, and the thumb's lightness, which inverts from a light thumb (off) to a graphite thumb (on). The off thumb is theme-varying, so it lives in the theme overlays.

thumb-size.$description: The default track height. Derived from the 32px track width at the design's 1.74:1 ratio, so it is not a scale step.
